info.name: nodets-app API
info.description:
All REST endpoints of nodets-app, generated from the route definitions in the code on 4 October 2026 (branch rag-system).

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to where the server runs. No endpoint requires authentication. Requests with a file field need a file chosen before sending. The WebSocket endpoints (`/ws/server`, `/ws/stream`, `/ws/chatAI`) cannot be stored in a v2.1 collection; their contract is in the endpoint spreadsheet.
